title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Diptan in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Antonio De Padua of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Diptan in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Antonio De Padua of Said Municipality

text.en: The sitio of Diptan, in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of San Antonio de Padua of said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
